import json
h,w=17,19
g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
points=[(3,4),(8,11),(13,6)]
for r,c in points:
    # top cap
    for j in range(c-2,c+3): g[r-2][j]=5
    # three vertical frame rows, with 5 at center of upper side row
    for rr in (r-1,r,r+1):
        g[rr][c-2]=2; g[rr][c+2]=2
    g[r-1][c]=5
    g[r][c]=3
    # long baseline, with an 8-colored local segment
    g[r+2]=[2]*w
    for j in range(c-2,c+3): g[r+2][j]=8
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g},separators=(',',':')))
